macro_vs_recursive_micro.notes: Direct macro vs recursive micro under strictly matched 24-candidate search.

condition_A_vs_F_equivalence.explanation: Condition F minimizes prior cost against a_react, identically selecting candidate 0 (a_react).

computational_efficiency.scientific_note: Hardware inference efficiency (cycles/latency) characterizes implementation throughput. It must not be conflated with the scientific hypothesis of causal lookahead utility, which is established only if Macro significantly outperforms Shuffled Binding.
